subject: CORRECTION to 0c85e209: in the L19 S3 frame the breather is on his RIGHT cheek, the lock's side, not mirrored; only the ear hoops and brow ring are mirrored; second handoff revised and rehashed; the L07 S4 mirror burst recorded as Episode 8's hero still after a repair, not a test clip
body:
The one-agent fact check of the second handoff viewed the frame against the breather decision and the lock and found one side read backwards by me: the tube runs from the clip under the nostrils across the VIEWER-LEFT cheek into the hair, which is his RIGHT cheek, exactly where DECISION-LAG-BREATHER-V3 and gemini_instructions section 2 put it. The hoops and the brow ring sit on the same viewer-left side, so they are on his right and mirrored from the lock; the nostril hoop is on his left, the lock's side. Grok's intake QA said only "piercings mirrored", which agrees with the image. So the breather needs no acceptance from Ziggy; the mirrored ear hoops and brow ring are the inherited drift. Everything else in the handoff passed (provenance, ledger fields, QA wording, the visible carriers, the raised hand as his right, the maw and fire at screen-right, the native-length wording, lighting as sources, the placements labelled proposed).

Revised file: SECOND_CLIP_HANDOFF_20261014.md, sha256 aceff0229a951f47cd885e1de959e5561bdb41df8f36c66290b385f3c7321fd8, 6,288 bytes (supersedes aceff…'s predecessor 6c9a4a6a… attached to 0c85e209). DECISIONS item 50 and open item 19 corrected the same way.

Also recorded (DECISIONS item 51): Ziggy's L07 "S4 breaking out" frame (LAG500-L07-S4, sha256 f704793a34ca2dc2a446ecc6b5ab52e9f5a263841627e60684dfdaa32f5d7c67, 428,377 bytes; Grok QA: AL garbled into another glyph; viewed by me at full size, L3 S5 preliminary: hoops on both ears, chin lettering faint, the worms and eyes right). It is the two-worlds spine in one frame (Episode 8's return through the mirror; the camp at the fire as the Panhandlers) and my recommendation is a chin-and-brow repair and then Episode 8's hero still, not a third test clip now: shards in slow motion, a crowd and body-to-ground contact would add three variables at once, against the one-variable rule the first two tests follow. No handoff for it; nothing requested of the Chief; the site shows Ziggy's review request for it queued for Gemini and Flow, not sent.
